correctness.rationale: Induction via exchangeability and an elementary symmetric PGF; Gauss–Lucas exclusion yields only real nonpositive zeros. Exact first- and second-order missing probabilities give variance asymptotics. Standard Bernoulli Stein Lipschitz bound gives <=2/sigma, and periodic lattice test gives >=(1/4-o(1))/sigma. Analytic quantified proof plus independently replayed 949 exact moment instances and 88 root isolations; finite checks not substituted for proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Existing stable-polynomial methods could imply a part of the representation after an application; the new proof supplies that model-specific implication, then deduces an optimal-order rate not entailed by the published bounds for alpha<=1/3. The larger-alpha rate is already bounded above in the primary article, but its sharpness is justified here by lattice lower bound.
